name: Phentermine
summary: Psychostimulant of the substituted amphetamine class. The drug is used medically as an appetite suppressant.

pharmacology.text: Phentermine is a norepinephrine and dopamine releasing agent (NDRA) and produces stimulant, rewarding, and appetite suppressant effects.
pharmacology.kind: Psychostimulant; Appetite suppressant; Norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent

uses.text: Phentermine is used for a short period of time to promote weight loss, if exercise and calorie reduction are not sufficient, and in addition to exercise and calorie reduction. Phentermine is approved for up to 12 weeks of use and most weight loss occurs in the first weeks. However, significant loss continues through the sixth month and has been shown to continue at a slower rate through the ninth month.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include a fast heart beat, high blood pressure, trouble sleeping, dizziness, and restlessness. Serious side effects may include abuse, but do not include pulmonary hypertension or valvular heart disease, as the latter complications were caused by the fenfluramine component of the "fen-phen" combination.

summaryZh: 芬特明商品名有 Ionamin、Sentis 等，是一種擬交感胺類的食慾抑制劑，其機制為通過刺激中樞神經系統以輔助短期治療肥胖症。其通用名由phenyl-tertiary-butylamine中幾個加了底線的文字所組成，是種苯基叔丁胺。
